call_points.text: MIBK, MIBC and acetophenone to be commissioned in August; rest of the projects within Q2.
Phenol import duty, removed for the whole of Q1, has been reimposed, supporting domestic producers.
No new global phenol capacity coming up; China largely self-sufficient, India demand balanced with limited supply.
Advanced Intermediates new products to have margins in line or better than segment average; management declined to quantify.
Analyst asked for phenol spread; management declined to comment on spreads.
Analyst asked for incremental revenue and EBITDA from new products; management declined to quantify.
Polycarbonate compounds qualified with customers including Mahindra, Panasonic, Goldmedal and Tata AutoComp.
Q1FY27 expected to be better than Q4FY26 on both standalone and consolidated basis.
FY27 standalone margin profile expected to be stronger than FY26, driven by new downstream products.
Polycarbonate project cost around ₹11,000 Cr, funded 60:40 debt-equity, commissioning by June 2028.
MIBK/MIBC and agrochemical intermediates projects scheduled for commissioning in Q2FY27.
Nitric acid plant ran at about 45% utilisation in Q4 due to technical issues; company bought from market.
Q4 EBITDA margin improved to 18% from 11% in Q3, helped by low-cost feedstock and better realisations.
Company secured feedstock on dips in Q4, expecting benefit to continue into Q1 and possibly Q2.
Domestic demand stable across automotive, infrastructure, pharma and polymers; export logistics disrupted by Strait of Hormuz.
China's constraints on certain chemistries seen as a tailwind for nitration products; already happening on ground.
Net worth ₹5,869 Cr; bank funding tied up for projects, equity being invested first.
Receivable days increased; company shifted to dealership and CSA model to secure outstanding.
Management declined to share production volumes for phenol, citing policy.

timeline.summary: Deepak Nitrite's subsidiary Deepak Chem Tech allotted ₹150 Cr in preference shares to Deepak Phenolics on April 30, 2026.
Deepak Chem Tech entered into a long-term agreement with Praxair India on April 30, 2026, to build a HyCO plant for its polycarbonate project.
Deepak Nitrite Limited, via **Arvind Bajpai**, scheduled Q4 & FY2026 earnings conference call for **May 18, 2026, at 3:30 PM IST**, hosted by IIFL Capital.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,120.33 Cr (-2.7% YoY), net profit ₹219.83 Cr (+8.6% YoY).
Deepak Nitrite Limited’s Board, led by **Arvind Bajpai**, recommended a **Rs. 7.5 final dividend (375%)** on 136,393,041 shares for FY2026.
Arvind Bajpai, CFO, uploaded Q4 & FY 2026 earnings call recording on May 18, 2026, via https://www.godeepak.com/financial-result/.

Deepak Nitrite's Q4 & FY26 earnings call (May 18, 2026) guided Q1FY27 above Q4, detailed ₹11,000 Cr polycarbonate project funding (60:40 debt-equity) and June 2028 commissioning, and noted nitric acid plant at 45% utilisation.
On May 30, 2026, Deepak Chem Tech Limited allotted 1,20,00,000 9% OCRPS of ₹100 each aggregating ₹120.00 Crores to Deepak Phenolics Limited.
Deepak Nitrite reported record Q1FY27 revenue of ₹2,592 Cr and PAT of ₹345 Cr, and said the entire debt for its ₹11,500 Cr polycarbonate project was tied up.
Deepak Nitrite Limited’s **Arvind Bajpai** announced Q2 & H1 FY27 earnings conference call on **30 October 2026 at 3:30 PM IST** via IIFL Capital.
